Nina G: Heads-up — Atlas POC (enterprise) hitting flakey first-token times. Some TTFT ~1.1s, others ~320ms. They saw sporadic 429s during ramp. Need quick triage for Friday decision. Can runtime + oncall help?

Tom H: Sharing minimal repro and a couple request_ids. Their workload: long system prompt (~1.2k tokens) + short user messages, many unique conversation ids per user.

Sofia R: That pattern == prefix-cache cold misses. Quick fixes: enable route-level prefix_cache, lower batch latency to 10ms for the model, and ask client to reuse conversation ids during the test. Also set client retries to exponential backoff (200ms base).

Sofia R: Temporary route override I can deploy:
```
route: atlas-enterprise-poc
prefix_cache: true
batch_latency_ms: 10
max_new_tokens: 96
stream_chunk_size: 64
```

Victor L: 429s look like throttling from burst protection. We can raise their burst allowance for 12 hours while they run the trial. Need their account id to apply.

Omar S: I uploaded traces to s3://redwood-support/poc/atlas/1830012345 and sent account id to Victor. Also started security questionnaire thread — they asked about KMS and VPC options.

ops-bot: change 2025-02-11T09:12:03Z: applied route override atlas-enterprise-poc (change id ch-4421).

Sofia R: After override in staging, median TTFT with session reuse dropped from ~650ms to ~240ms. Cold unique sessions still ~470ms. Recommend customer adopt per-user sticky convo ids for long-term.

Tom H: Customer will switch load generator to reuse sessions for next window (scheduled in 30m). I'll post results here.

Nina G: Sales asks: rough Dedicated pricing and quick eligibility call for security. Victor/Omar can follow up. Thanks all.
